cues.text: AI as a software rendering engine.
In CEMIVO, the interface itself is generated output.
The whole screen, your words, and each click become the next rendering request.
DeepSeek plans the layout. Trained neural decoders turn it into pixels.
For a small change, update a region. For a new goal, generate a new view.
The agent executes the task. Its result becomes the next interface.
CEMIVO. Exploring AI as the rendering layer of software.
